parts.name: OTPFieldRoot
parts.description: Holds the code and shares it with the slots inside it, as a group (`role="group"`). It also renders a visually hidden text input that holds the whole code for the form, with the code's `name`, `pattern` and `required`.

props.name: length
props.description: The number of slots. Render this many OTPFieldInput parts.

props.name: value
props.description: The code. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the field. Focus moves on to the next slot once the new value shows, so an owner that doesn't take a change leaves focus where it was. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The code at first, when it isn't controlled; also what a form reset puts back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called whenever the code changes. Receives the code and details whose `reason` is `input-change` (typing, or a fill), `input-clear` (typing that emptied a slot, or a form reset back to empty), `input-paste` or `keyboard` (Backspace and Delete). It is called in a change of its own, so it may save or write something a loading question reads without holding the field.

props.name: onValueComplete
props.description: When the last empty slot is filled by typing, a fill or a paste, or a whole code is pasted over a complete one. Called after `onValueChange`, once the value has changed (for a controlled value, once its owner took it).

props.name: onValueInvalid
props.description: Typed or pasted text had characters the field dropped (outside the validation type, or past the last slot). `value` is the text as entered.

props.name: validationType
props.description: Which characters a slot takes. Default "numeric".

props.name: normalizeValue
props.description: Rewrites entered text after whitespace and the validation type are applied (`(v) => v.toUpperCase()`); its result is filtered again and cut to `length`. It runs more than once on one edit, so it must give the same result when run on its own output.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: The first slot's and the hidden input's `autocomplete`. Default "one-time-code".

props.name: mask
props.description: Shows each character as a dot (`type="password"` on the slots).

props.name: autoSubmit
props.description: Submits the form (as its submit button would) when the code is complete.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the slots can't be changed or focused. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot. A field disabled while a slot has focus (`disabled={pending? check}`) gives focus back to a slot when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the slots can be focused and moved between but not changed. `readOnly={pending? check}` keeps the code as it is while it is checked, without losing focus.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the code is needed for the form to be valid: every slot, and the hidden input, is then required.

props.name: name
props.description: With a name (or inside a named FieldRoot), the code is submitted with the form under it.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form the code belongs to, when it isn't inside it.

props.name: id
props.description: The first slot's id, which a `<label for>` names; the others are `${id}-2`, `${id}-3`…

dataAttributes.name: data-complete
dataAttributes.description: Present when every slot is filled.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the code has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when at least one slot is filled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while a slot has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once focus has left the slots at least once.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.

parts.name: OTPFieldInput
parts.description: One character's slot: a native text input. Typing fills it and moves to the next; Backspace empties it (or the slot before, from an empty one) and moves back; Delete takes its character out; the arrow keys, Home and End move between slots, and Ctrl or Cmd with an arrow goes to the first slot or the first empty one. A paste or several characters at once are spread from it. Takes every attribute of an `<input>`; a `type` given here wins over `mask`, and an `aria-label` is kept on every slot but the first.

dataAttributes.name: data-complete
dataAttributes.description: Present when every slot is filled.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the code has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when this slot holds a character.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while any slot of the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once focus has left the slots at least once.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.

parts.name: OTPFieldSeparator
parts.description: A separator between groups of slots (`role="separator"`). It carries no behaviour.
